title: SB2406 (2018 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2018/bills/SB2406_.HTM; sha256 0771bfd8f2a99112879ef1b8f926e1bdc8369ae14179369dfcdd3eac5d9bb964)
provenance.note: Introduced text. The bill rewrites the whole list in HRS 134-8(a), so bracketed words are re-lettering only; only new item (9) is quoted; items 1-8 are existing law re-lettered. Any amendments after filing are not in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (HRS 134-8): (9) Bump stocks, gat cranks, or any devices that can allow a person to manipulate the trigger mechanism of a firearm more rapidly than the person could without the device.
